spans.text: Those who are part of the Sect of the Stained are likely to not identify as a cult, or even a religion - they act in reverence to their god in the same way that a gladiator would pray to the gods: as a matter of luck and favor, more so than a relationship based on divine guidance. They are killers, murderers, psychopaths, and those who are more bestial in nature than their fellow man. Even on their own, they seek out victims to rend limb from limb.
